title: Mail license
loadError: The license could not be loaded. Refresh before continuing.
equalPrice: Mail is purchased per mailbox, with the same price for people and agents. This license's terms are separate from the Send service.
includedSummary: {storage} and {messages, number} recipients per mailbox / period
existingLicenseBody: This team's Mail license is already registered. Contracts and internal pilots use the mailboxes and period shown above. To renew or change the quantity, contact the installation operator; do not open another subscription.
existingBody: This team already has a recorded Mail purchase and the license is awaiting confirmation. Refresh the status. If it remains pending, contact the installation operator; do not open another subscription.
recoveryBody: A purchase was started under earlier terms. It must be resolved before a new subscription.
adminBody: Only the team owner or an administrator can subscribe when purchasing is available. Suspended teams cannot purchase.
unavailableBody: Purchasing through the dashboard is not available in this installation yet. Ask the installation operator for the terms to enable a Mail license. Prices and allowances must be approved before purchasing.
recoveryReads: Stored messages remain available for reading and export by people with access to the mailbox.
quantityHint: From 1 to 10,000 mailboxes. A person or agent uses one mailbox each.
quantityLocked: This purchase's quantity has been preserved. Trying again checks the same purchase.
checkoutTerms: Review the final amount and terms in Stripe's secure checkout before confirming.
pendingBody: The purchase is pending confirmation. Check again with the same quantity. If it remains pending, it requires assistance; do not start another purchase.
checkoutError: This purchase expired. Refresh the status before trying again.
confirmationHint: Opening checkout or returning from it does not activate the license. Access changes only after service confirmation.
awaitingConfirmation: You returned from checkout. Wait for license confirmation and refresh the status whenever you wish.
confirmed: The service confirms that the license is active.
